title: BLIS leaderboard run record
description: One blis run: the work offered, the candidate under test, and what BLIS returned. Targets `blis run` / `blis replay` output only — the search tool's {config, metrics} shape would half-validate against this one.

run_id.description: Unique within a group; also the result filename.

workload_name.description: The catalog name (a preset or saved profile) the run was declared with, for display only. Optional and not part of group_id/work_id, which hash the model-free group: the name never changes which table a run lands in. Absent for a runs.yaml run, which names no workload.

metrics_raw.description: Everything blis emitted, verbatim, minus requests[] — which is 97% of the bytes and belongs in the sidecar.

group.description: The comparability key: the work offered. Model and hardware are deliberately absent (D4, E1): both are candidates under test, so a table is one workload spanning models and hardware.

horizon_ticks.description: --horizon. null = unbounded. Bounds the observation window, so it bounds the group (A4).

request_timeout_s.description: --timeout. Negative disables it; 0 is rejected by blis.

workload.description: Two variants share this object, discriminated by `type` (§4). The base declares every field loosely; the value constraints that make a `distribution` workload well-formed live in the conditional below, so a `workload-spec` record — whose distribution fields are unused zeros — is not rejected by them. Keeping one object (rather than a oneOf) keeps the generated Workload a single type, so existing readers of `num_requests`/`load` are unchanged.

type.description: --workload. `distribution` is the flat synthetic shape; `workload-spec` carries an inline blis WorkloadSpec in `spec` and reaches the full workload surface.

arrival_process.description: DERIVED, not reported: SynthesizeFromDistribution sets ArrivalSpec{Process: "constant"} for rate mode (../inference-sim/sim/workload/synthesis.go:33). Poisson is reachable only via --workload-spec. Not applicable to the spec variant (arrival lives inside `spec`), where it holds the placeholder "constant".

spec_file.description: --workload-spec provenance: the sibling file a spec was authored from, if any. A catalog-inline profile leaves it null and carries the spec in `spec`.

spec_sha256.description: Content hash of the inline `spec`, folded into group_id. Null for the distribution variant.

spec.description: The inline blis WorkloadSpec (v2), model-free, for the workload-spec variant. Absent for distribution.

load.description: Exactly one kind, so an open-loop run and a closed-loop run can never share a group.

value.description: Offered load; > 0 for the distribution variant (enforced there). 0 is the not-applicable placeholder a workload-spec record carries.

deployment.description: The candidate under test. Every field is written even when it holds a BLIS default, so canonicalisation is stable and the UI can tell which fields vary across a table.

model.description: Org-prefixed, as defaults.yaml is keyed. A candidate dimension (E1): the reader filters and ranks it beside hardware.

tp.description: Effectively required: trained-physics refuses to run without it.

enable_expert_parallel.description: --enable-expert-parallel. MoE models only, --latency-model trained-physics only; blis fatally rejects it on a dense model. Omitted when false (the blis default), so a record without expert parallelism is canonically unchanged.

moe_comm_backend.description: --moe-comm-backend. MoE all-to-all backend (latency.ValidMoECommBackends); needs a MoE model, trained-physics, and either dp>1 or enable_expert_parallel. "" means unset (blis default) and is omitted.

disaggregation.description: Prefill/decode disaggregation (the PD pool topology and its KV-transfer physics). Present only when a pool is set — a non-disaggregated record omits it entirely, so its canonical form is unchanged (cf. routing_scorers, workload.spec). When present, the pool counts satisfy cluster.ValidatePoolTopology: their sum is <= num_instances, and prefill and decode are both set unless prefill_decode_instances (the shared-role pool) is.

prefill_decode_instances.description: --prefill-decode-instances. Shared-role instances serving both (llm-d 'both' parity; 0 = none).

decider.description: --pd-decider. When a request is disaggregated. Emitted when not "never".

prefix_threshold.description: --pd-prefix-threshold. Non-cached-token threshold for the prefix-threshold decider (blis default 16); emitted only for that decider.

transfer_bandwidth.description: --pd-transfer-bandwidth. KV transfer bandwidth in GB/s (blis default 25.0). Emitted when it differs from the default.

transfer_base_latency.description: --pd-transfer-base-latency. KV transfer base latency in ms (blis default 0.05). Emitted when it differs from the default.

transfer_contention.description: --pd-transfer-contention. Fair-share bandwidth contention model. Emitted only when true.

max_model_len.description: 0 = unlimited (blis auto-derives from the HF config).

long_prefill_token_threshold.description: --long-prefill-token-threshold. 0 = off (chunked prefill never triggers); blis accepts 0. Always emitted.

routing_scorers.description: --routing-scorers: the weighted policy's name:weight profile (mirrors sim.ScorerConfig). Omitted unless routing_policy is "weighted", and emitted to the argv as name:w,name:w only then — so a non-weighted record's canonical form is byte-for-byte unchanged (cf. workload.spec's omitempty). blis warns if it is set for any other policy, and falls back to precise-prefix-cache:2,queue-depth:1,kv-utilization:1 when weighted with none given.

weight.description: Finite and > 0; blis normalizes the weights to sum to 1.

gpu_memory_utilization.description: --gpu-memory-utilization. Fraction of GPU memory for the KV cache, in (0, 1.0]. Always emitted; blis default 0.9.

num_speculative_tokens.description: --num-speculative-tokens (K). 0 = speculative decoding off. Emitted only when > 0.

speculative_acceptance_rate.description: --speculative-acceptance-rate. Mean fraction of draft tokens accepted, [0,1]. Emitted only when num_speculative_tokens > 0, where blis requires it.

speculative_method.description: --speculative-method. blis closes the set (sim/config.go isValidSpeculativeMethod); "" means unset. Emitted only when num_speculative_tokens > 0 and non-empty.

extra_flags.description: Flag names without leading dashes. Part of row identity; the UI renders every entry (A3).

blis_tree_dirty.description: Recorded and surfaced as a caveat, never a reason to block a run.

cwd.description: The working directory blis was executed from — ../inference-sim in normal use. blis resolves defaults.yaml, hardware_config.json, and model_configs/ relative to this directory, so it is recorded rather than assumed.

status.description: Derived from metrics by internal/status, never asserted by hand.

class.description: incomplete: the declared work did not finish. altered: every request finished, but not the declared work.

metrics.description: Exactly the sim.MetricsOutput fields declared without omitempty — the 27 BLIS always emits. internal/drift asserts this list against upstream source. Everything omitempty (cache_hit_rate, kv_allocation_failures, goodput_rps, slo_attainment, per_class, adapters, saturation) lives in metrics_raw.

injected_requests.description: Upstream computes this as completed + queued + running + dropped + timed_out (sim/metrics.go:102) — an identity, not an independent count.

responses_per_sec.description: Bounded above by the offered rate. Never rank on it.

tokens_per_sec.description: Also bounded by the offered rate at a single load.
